def jlog(event, **kw):
    rec = {"ts": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "event": event}
    rec.update(kw)
    with JOURNAL.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

def ledger(action, package, result, note=""):
    with LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"{datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}\t{action}\t{package}\t{result}\t{note}\n")

def get_mode(pkg):
    rc, so, se = adb("shell", "cmd", "appops", "get", "--user", "0", pkg)
    m = re.search(r"RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND:\s*(\w+)", so)
    return (m.group(1) if m else "ABSENT"), so

def main():
    if not LEDGER.exists():
        LEDGER.write_text("ts\taction\tpackage\tresult\tnote\n", encoding="utf-8")
    rc, so, se = adb("get-state")
    if so.strip() != "device":
        raise SystemExit("device not ready " + so)
    rc, disp, _ = adb("shell", "getprop", "ro.build.display.id")
    jlog("reapply_reduced_start", n=len(PKGS), display=disp.strip())
    results = []
    for pkg in PKGS:
        before, raw_before = get_mode(pkg)
        rc, so, se = adb("shell", "cmd", "appops", "set", "--user", "0", pkg, "RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND", "ignore")
        after, raw_after = get_mode(pkg)
        ok = after == "ignore"
        rec = {"package": pkg, "before": before, "set_rc": rc, "set_stdout": so.strip(), "set_stderr": se.strip(), "after": after, "ok": ok}
        results.append(rec)
        ledger("appops_set_ignore", pkg, "OK" if ok else "FAIL", f"before={before} after={after} rc={rc}")
        print(("OK" if ok else "FAIL"), pkg, before, "->", after, "rc", rc, so.strip()[:80], se.strip()[:80])
        if not ok:

    (OUT / "reapply_results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    fail = [r["package"] for r in results if not r["ok"]]
    jlog("reapply_reduced_done", ok=len(results)-len(fail), fail=fail, display=disp.strip())
    print("SUMMARY ok", len(results)-len(fail), "fail", fail)

if __name__ == "__main__":
